## Placeholder wiring

Applied as visual-only children (`ArtPlaceholder`) on gameplay prefabs via
`Tools → Space Factory → Apply Placeholder Art` (`Assets/Editor/PlaceholderArtApplier.cs`).

| Gameplay | Pack model |
|----------|------------|
| AutoTurret / HeavyTurret | Kenney Space Kit turrets |
| Barrier / Bulwark | Quaternius MegaKit short walls |
| RelayNode | Kenney Conveyor Kit `conveyor` |
| MiningDrill / TurboDrill / Processor | Kenney Factory Kit machines |
| PowerTap | Kenney Factory Kit valve pipe |
| ShockTrap | Quaternius Essentials mine |
| RepairPost | Kenney Factory Kit machine-window |
| Crawler / Bruiser | Quaternius MegaKit aliens |
| Sapper | Quaternius Essentials EyeDrone |
| Hub dressing props | Essentials crate/barrel/locker + Modular Space corridor |

## Notes

- Kenney packs: extracted **FBX** models (and **Textures** where included in the kit) plus each pack's `License.txt`.
- Quaternius packs: full archive contents extracted into the folders above.
